name: Docker
summary: Docker runs software in containers, and many agent setups use a container to keep an agent away from the host filesystem. Docker Sandboxes, managed with the sbx CLI, go further: each coding agent runs in its own microVM with its own kernel and Docker daemon, with only the project workspace mounted and network allow and deny lists. Sandboxes run locally for free or in Docker's cloud on a pay-as-you-go plan.
facts: MicroVM sandboxes on macOS and Windows; Linux uses container-based sandboxes
Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Kiro and others

goodFor: Running coding agents locally without touching the host

watchOut: Plain containers share the host kernel; weaker isolation than microVMs
